enemy_1373_ltnhor_2.evidenceBoundary: Full source declarations and template preserved; bridge and caller lifecycle are explicitly Inferred.

verified.claim: Selected enemy database level 0 declares maxSp=2, initSp=0, INCREASE_WITH_TIME and increment=0. Source zero is zero, not a missing-value default of 1.
Both exact prefabKey bindings declare spCost=2, cooldown=0, initCooldown=0 and priority=0.

Four normal ability sibling BuffToOwner components declare event 4 and a single immediate charge Buff; its complete template ON_BUFF_START graph contains only forced ModifySp +1 on BUFF_OWNER, ignoring SP type. Neither selected EnemySkill ability has that sibling.
AbilityStandard.Event.ON_CAST_START=2, ON_CAST_END=3, ON_SPELL_ON=4, ON_ATTACK_FINISH=6. Charge is not declared at cast start or attack finish.
FilterUtil.FilterType.HATRED_DES=4; DIST_TO_SOURCE_ASC=11. The candidate postFilter is hatred descending, not nearest distance.
Ability.FamilyGroupMask.ATTACK=1, COMBAT=2, ATTACK_OR_COMBAT=3. Candidate mask permits attack/combat families. Full CheckFamilyMask native body remains unreadable.

EnemySkill.CastToTarget first checks ability activeInHierarchy, calls TryReduceSp, then calls the ability cast virtual method. The negative SP modifier therefore precedes accepted cast progression; cast finish is not the deduction point.
TryReduceSp returns true for cost < 1; otherwise constructs Modifier.NewSp(-cost, owner, owner) and calls owner.ApplyModifier. There is no per-mode or per-skill SP storage in this branch.

After ability cast succeeds, CastToTarget fires the timer hook and cast-start virtual hook, increments its integer counter, calls OnCastSucceed, and returns true. OnCastSucceed registers this skill as a modifier.

Init clears the trigger counter, resets the timer with nonnegative overwriteInitCooldown or data.initCooldown, and clears modifier registration. Attach enables then attaches the ability; Detach detaches then disables it. Their visible bodies do not call Init or perform SP reset.
Enemy._GenerateSpData uses SpData.CreateFrom on the enemy data SP object when available, otherwise SpData.GetDefault.

inferred.claim: For this one-hit _waitForAttackEvent=1 RangedAttack family, bridge ON_SPELL_ON to the first animation OnAttack/projectile launch. Charge once per cast, independent of projectile hit success or target count. Native event-to-sibling bridge has not been fully restored.

Choose the highest source priority then stable declaration order among fully ready currently mounted skills before a new normal cast; an in-progress action owns the lane. Selected enemy has one eligible skill in each mode, so cross-skill priority does not affect these two consumers.

SP is owner-wide; retain per-skill cooldown/count state across mode detach/reattach and gate casting to the current mode. Source Attach/Detach do not initialize state, but complete Unit.ActivateMode/InactiveMode remains unreadable, so caller policy is not proven.
Reuse the current framework policy: a mode change cancels an unfinished cast but retains emitted projectiles and spent SP. Full native finish reason/refund behavior is not known.

Preserve existing main cooldown because resetMainAbilityCdWhenCastEnd=0; pause its countdown while the skill owns the action lane, matching the pinned community scheduler. Selected skill cooldown and initial cooldown are zero.

Use physical blocker first then existing engine hatred/taunt and deployment-order sorting, up to max_target=2. Enum is directly known; the complete engine hatred weighting and exact selector search cadence remain approximations.

communityDivergences.claim: Community spends SP at cast finish; native visible CastToTarget/TryReduceSp spends before invoking the ability. Use native ordering.
Community increment or 1.0 fallback treats source increment=0 as1; exact source zero must remain zero.

executionBoundary: Only the selected no-extra-Buff skill and its explicitly linked normal-ability charge graphs are supported.
Do not infer attack recovery from spCost; do not apply this gain to unrelated normal attacks or all EnemySkills.
Mode 1 skill is executable only when an actual caller activates mode 1; this does not implement the separate enthu transition.
Fields and static native branches do not establish live hotfix behavior or full enemy correctness.
